items.rss_summary: Hedge fund investors warned that stress is building across credit markets, with the weakest CCC borrowers particularly vulnerable as higher rates, loose documentation and deteriorating underwriting raise default risks. They also pointed to emerging strains in private credit and speculative AI financing, arguing that seemingly isolated pockets of weakness may be part of a broader repricing. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.original_title: Israeli spy chief lobbied for joint Iran strikes on US visit, sources say
items.rss_summary: By Alexander CornwellJERUSALEM, Nov 18 (Reuters) - The head of Israel's Mossad spy agency, Roman Gofman, advocated for joint US-Israeli strikes on Iran during meetings with US officials last week, according to two people briefed on the visit.Gofman met with Trump administration officials, including CIA Director John Ratcliffe, in Washington, the people said, adding that the Mossad chief briefed the officials on Israeli intelligence on Iran.
